svg.title: EPIFAT — state-registered cardiac CT software (No. 2025610317): Attention U-Net pericardium segmentation, reported Dice 0.91 in a single run with patient-level splitting; GUI + CLI, manual correction and radiomics. Training data and held-out predictions are private; this is a research result, not a clinical qualification claim.
